meta.title: Engineering delivery plan
meta.focus: Deliver the migration foundations and validate the first use case with the core engineering team.

items.name: BFF and functional services knowledge on the gap analysis
items.body: The board places the BFF and the functional services under Digital Software Engineering, the estate the migration gaps are read against. The engineering lead knows the BFF and sits on the evolution front.
items.note: TRK-06 reads the migration strategy against that estate. The time allocated to this analysis comes out of the evolution lane's capacity.

decision.text: Time on the gap analysis comes out of the evolution lane's capacity.

items.name: Confirm the first use case and its acceptance evidence
items.body: Agree the acceptance evidence with the team before implementation starts.

items.name: Migration strategy and functional service assessment
items.body: Review the service boundaries, agree the migration sequence and document the responsibilities for the next delivery window.

items.name: Shared specialists may be unavailable during the assessment window
items.body: Several teams need the same specialists during the discovery period.
items.note: Reserve named contributors and agree their availability at the weekly planning session.

items.name: The engineering team can access the existing documentation
items.body: The current service documentation is available to the assessment team.
items.note: Capture gaps and assign an owner for each missing service description.

items.name: Core team review and acceptance of the migration strategy

gates.name: Accept the service assessment and agree the implementation window
gates.evidence: Reviewed service assessment and named implementation owners

log.text: DEP-007 was agreed. TRK-06 uses the evolution lane's allocated capacity.
